purpose: Couple P22C frequency-dependent voice-coil current and amplifier output limits with P15A-inspired two-state Cauer coil/motor model and Re(T); test when ideal state-aware protection can gain vs mechanical-only. Study scenarios, NOT measured Dayton thermal properties or deployable miniDSP limiter.
warnings: Rth/Cth parameters are intentionally uncalibrated with approximately order-of-magnitude variation; NO factory Dayton temperature limits are known.
80 K coil temperature RISE is arbitrary diagnostic contour, NOT safe operating limit.
Peak guard at 0.8*Xmax is hypothetical ideal-model safety factor, not measured mechanical clearance.
Temperature oracle reads exact internal state at every time step. Neither miniDSP Flex Eight nor Flex HTx is verified to run this observer/control.
Small-signal BL,Cms,Le fixed, no BL(x)/Cms(x)/power compression/multitone; one sinus repeated with burst duty, NOT actual music spectrum.
AMP 4-ohm 1kHz power is only reference voltage cap; output time/current/thermal not measured. Only the manufacturer Ipeak reference is modeled.
Stop at 200 K rise to avoid extrapolating nonlinear thermal model into nonsensical temperatures.
